title: SITE-Seq: A Genome-wide Method to Measure Cas9 Cleavage
protocol: Use a 1 x10^7 cells/mL suspension based on a 10mL suspension.
Add 10mL ice-cold C1 Buffer and 30mL ice-cold molecular biology-grade water to the cell suspension.
Mix by inverting the tube several times.
Incubate on ice for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge lysed cells at 4°C for 15 min at 1,300 x g.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash with 2mL of ice-cold C1 and 6mLof ice-cold water.
Resuspend by vortexing.
Centrifuge again at 4°C for 15 min at 1,300 x g.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend in 10mL G2 by vortexing for 10-30s at maximum speed.
Add 200µL of QIAGEN Protease and incubate at 50°C for 30-60 minutes.
Vortex the digested suspension sample for 10s at maximum speed.
Apply the vortexed sample to an equilibrated Qiagen Genomic-tip 500/G column, allow to empty by gravity flow.
If the column becomes clogged, apply positive pressure but do not exceed 20-40 drops/min.
Wash the Genomic-tip column twice with 15 mL QC.
Elute genomic DNA with 15 mL of Buffer QF.
Preheat Buffer QF to 50°C to increase yields.
Add 10.5 mL of room temperature isopropanol to eluted DNA and mix by inverting tube 10-20 times.
Centrifuge at >5,000 x g for 15 min at 4°C after mixing.
Remove supernatant and wash with 4 mL cold 70% ethanol.
Centrifuge again for 10 min at >5,000 x g and remove supernatant.
Allow DNA to air-dry for 5-10 minutes.
Resuspend in 0.5-1 mL of TE or 10 mM Tris-Cl buffer on a shaker overnight or at 55°C for 1-2 hours, without vortexing.
Ensure genomic DNA is fully thawed and well mixed before handling.
Prepare a 1% agarose gel by adding 0.5 g to 50 mL of 1x TAE buffer per gel.
Heat sample until agarose is in solution, swirl.
Add 10,000x SYBR Safe gel stain and pour the gel.
Allow the gel to cool for ~30 minutes.
Load 10 µL DNA ladder and 0.5-1.5 µg of HMW gDNA mixed with loading dye.
Run the gel at 85-100 V for ~1-2 hrs.
Make up 5x Cas9 Cleavage buffer according to specifications.
Remove reagents from -20°C or -80°C, allow to thaw on ice.
Dilute sgRNAs to target concentration in 15 µL water.
Heat the sgRNAs to 95°C for 2 min, then let cool to room temperature for ~5 minutes.
During Step 4, dilute Cas9 in CCB buffer and water such that each reaction is 15 µL of 3.3x CCB buffer and 3.3x final Cas9 concentration.
Mix the diluted Cas9 from step 5 with the re-folded sgRNAs from step 4 and incubate at 37°C for 10 min.
Dilute the HMW gDNA to ~500 ng/µL.
Add 20 µL of diluted HMW gDNA to each RNP reaction.
Incubate cleavage reaction at 37°C for 4 hours.
Add 6.8 μL of Proteinase K/RNase A mix to each cleavage reaction.
Mix well by pipetting.
Incubate the sample at 37°C for 20 minutes, then at 55°C for 20 minutes.
Proceed to DNA cleanup with SPRIselect Reagent.
Add one volume (56.8 μL) of SPRISelect reagent to the sample.
Ensure that beads and gDNA are well mixed.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place the sample on a compatible magnetic stand, allow beads to pellet for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant.
Wash twice with 175 μL freshly prepared 85% ethanol.
Remove supernatant after 30 seconds for each wash.
Let ethanol evaporate for 10 minutes until beads are dry.
Add 50 μL of water, mix until beads are resuspended.
Incubate the reaction mixture at room temperature for 5-10 minutes.
Place the reaction mixture back on the magnetic stand, and allow beads to fully pellet.
Transfer 45 µL of elution to a fresh tube.
Continue to the dA-tailing reaction step or store the sample at -20°C until the next step can be started.
Remove NEBNext® dA-tailing reagents from -20°C and allow to thaw on ice.
Assemble the following reaction using the NEBNext® dA-tailing module: Cas9-treated gDNA (42 µL), dA-tailing reaction buffer (10x) (5 µL), Klenow Fragment (3 µL).
Incubate the reaction at 37°C for 30 min.
Make up 2x annealing buffer according to the following: 20 mM Tris, pH 7.5, 100 mM NaCl, 2 mM EDTA.
Assemble adapter 1 according to the following: Adapter 1 For (1 µL), Adapter 1 Rev (1 µL), Water (8 µL), 2x annealing buffer (10 µL).
Incubate the adapter 1 mixture at 95°C for 5 minutes, then let the reaction cool to RT for ~45 minutes.
Assemble the ligation reaction according to the following: dA-tailed DNA (38 µL), Adapter 1 (2 µL), T4 DNA Ligase buffer (10x) (5 µL), NEB Quick Ligase (5 µL).
Incubate the ligation reaction at 20°C for 30 minutes, then 16°C overnight.
Proceed to SPRISelect reagent cleanup 2.
Add 0.5x volumes (25 μL) of SPRISelect reagent to the sample.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 5 min at RT.
Place the sample on a compatible magnetic stand, allow beads to pellet for 5 min.
Remove supernatant.
Wash twice with 175 µL freshly prepared 85% ethanol. Remove supernatant after 30s for each wash.
Let ethanol evaporate for 10 minutes until beads are dry.
Remove from the magnetic stand and add 50 μl of water, mix until beads are resuspended.
Incubate the reaction mixture at room temperature for 5-10 min at RT.
Place the reaction mixture back on the magnetic stand, and allow beads to fully pellet.
Transfer 45 µl of elution to a fresh tube.
Remove NEBNext® dsDNA Fragmentase® reagents from -20°C and allow them to thaw on ice.
Vortex the dsFragmentase to ensure it is well mixed.
Assemble the fragmentation reaction with 40 µL of adapter 1-ligated DNA, 5 µL of dsFragmentase Buffer v2 (10x), 1.5 µL of dsFragmentase Enzyme, and 3.5 µL of water to a total volume of 50 µL.
Incubate the reaction at 37°C for one hour.
Quench the reaction by adding 12.5 µL of 0.5M EDTA, mix by pipetting up and down.
Add 37.5 µL of water to the quenched reaction mixture.
Add 0.9x volume (90 µL) of SPRISelect reagent to the sample.
Ensure that beads and gDNA are well mixed thoroughly.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 5 min at room temperature.
Place the sample on a compatible magnetic stand.
Allow beads to pellet for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant.
Wash twice with 175 µL freshly prepared 85% ethanol.
Remove supernatant after 30 seconds for each wash.
Let ethanol evaporate for 10 minutes until beads are dry.
Remove from the magnetic stand and add 50 μL of water.
Mix until beads are resuspended.
Incubate the reaction mixture at room temperature for 5-10 min.
Place the reaction mixture back on the magnetic stand.
Allow beads to fully pellet.
Transfer 45 µL of elution to a fresh tube.
Remove NEBNext Ultra End Repair / dA-tailing module reagents from -20°C.
Thaw on ice.
Assemble the end-repair reaction as follows: fragmented DNA (from step H) (27.7 μL), End-Repair Buffer (10x) (3.3 μL), End-Repair Enzyme Mix (1.5 μL), Water (0.5 μL).
Incubate reaction at 20°C for 30 minutes.
Incubate reaction at 65°C for 30 minutes.
Incubate the adapter 2 mixture at 95°C for 5 minutes, then let the reaction cool to RT for ~45 minutes.
Assemble the ligation reaction using End-repaired DNA and Adapter 2 at 12.5 µM concentration.
Add Blunt/TA Ligase Master Mix and Ligation enhancer to the ligation mixture.
Affinity purification with Streptavidin beads begins by preparing 2x block and wash buffer for Dynabead procedure.
Remove Dynabeads from 4°C, mix gently by inverting the tube.
Wash one volume of dynabead mixture with five volumes of 1x B&W Buffer, rotating beads for 5 minutes.
Place washed Dynabead mixture on magnetic stand, allow time to pellet (~5 min), remove supernatant.
Repeat steps involving washing and pelleting of Dynabeads.
Resuspend beads in 41 µL of 2x B&W Buffer.
Add 41 µL to the adapter-ligated DNA.
Rotate the bead/DNA mixture for 30 minutes at room temperature with gentle inversion.
Place samples on a magnetic stand and allow beads to pellet for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant from the pellets.
Wash the beads by adding 200 µL of 1xB&W buffer, incubate for 30 seconds, then remove supernatant.
Repeat washing step once with 1xB&W buffer and a second time with 10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.5.
Add 20 µL of 10 mM Tris-HCl to the beads and mix by pipetting up and down several times.
Assemble a PCR reaction using bead mixture, Recovery PCR Forward primer, Recovery PCR Reverse primer, and Q5 Hot-Start 2x Master Mix in the specified volumes.
Run thermal cycler program starting with denaturation at 98°C for 2 minutes.
Cycle through steps: 98°C for 10 seconds, 61°C for 30 seconds, 72°C for 2 minutes, repeating 12 times total.
Complete the PCR by incubating at 72°C for 2 minutes followed by holding at 4°C.
Remove samples from thermal cycler and place on a magnetic stand; allow beads to pellet for 5 minutes.
Transfer 30 µL of supernatant to a fresh tube.
Dilute the supernatant by adding 3 µL of recovery PCR product to 148.5 µL of water.
Set up the indexing PCR using 12 µL of diluted recovery PCR DNA.
Add 4 µL of index primer forward (5 µM).
Add 4 µL of index primer reverse (5 µM).
Add 20 µL of Q5 2x Master Mix.
Incubate at 98°C for 2 min.
Cycle through the following steps:
Heat to 98°C for 10s.
Heat to 60°C for 30s.
Incubate at 72°C for 2 min.
Repeat Steps 2-4 a total of 11 times (for 12 cycles).
Incubate at 72°C for 2 min.
Hold the reaction mixture at 4°C.
Pool all samples from the indexing PCR step, using between 5 µL and 40 µL per sample to create a final pool of ~200-1000 µL.
Add 0.7x volume of SPRIselect reagent to the pooled sample.
Mix well by pipetting up and down.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 5 min at room temperature (RT).
Place the reaction tube on a magnetic stand, then pellet the beads for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Wash twice with 1 mL of freshly prepared 85% ethanol for 30 seconds each time.
Let the ethanol evaporate for 10-15 minutes until beads are dry.
Add 1 volume of water to the tube, mix by pipetting up and down.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 10 min at RT.
Place the reaction tube back on a magnetic stand, then pellet the beads for 5 min.
Transfer 0.95x volume of water to a new tube.
PAUSE POINT: Libraries can be stored at -20°C or proceed to desired method of library quantification prior to sequencing.
Dilute the final library 1:10 and 1:5 by volume in molecular biology grade water.
Load each diluted sample on an Agilent Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA chip.
If more than 25% of the library is above 1,000bp, perform a 0.5x right-side SPRI cleanup to adjust the size range.
Add 0.5x volume of SPRIselect reagent to the pooled sample and mix well by pipetting up and down.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 5 min at room temperature.
Place the reaction plate on a magnetic stand, then pellet the beads for 5 min.
Remove supernatant and transfer into a fresh tube.
Add 1.2x volumes of SPRIselect reagent, repeat incubation and pelleting steps.
Wash twice with 30 sec each using 1 mL freshly prepared 85% ethanol.
Let ethanol evaporate for 10-15 min until beads are dry.
Remove the reaction plate from the magnetic stand, then add 1 volume of water and mix up and down by pipetting.
Incubate the mixture for 10 min at room temperature.
Place the sample back on a magnetic stand, then pellet the beads for 5 min.
Transfer 0.9x volume of water to a new tube.
Proceed to desired method of library quantification prior to sequencing.
Quantify library using preferred method.
We recommend either qPCR or Qubit 3.0 for quantification.
If necessary, repeat the 0.7x SPRI from Step M to remove any residual adapter dimer/small fragments from the library.
Required sequencing depth will depend on library quality and the particular application.
2-3 million reads (150 bp, single-end) per sample is recommended.
